attack_type: normal | http_flood | brute_force | sqli | ssrf | exfiltration
source_ref: String or null (path/identifier of the original raw JSON file - used instead of embedding trace_payload at bulk scale)
trace_payload: Object or null (only embedded for retention_class=long_term_attack; bulk normal traces reference source_ref instead)
expires_at: ISODate or null (null = long_term_attack, never auto-deleted by the TTL index)
